title: Aloo ka Bhurta (Spicy Mashed Potatoes)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Somewhere between mashed potatoes and home fries, left lumpy, with browned onions for sweetness. Good on its own with bread or beside a meat or vegetable dish.

steps.action: Cover with water by 1 in (2.5 cm); bring to a boil on high, then cover and cook on medium (5/10) 30 min. Drain:
Heat in a large frying pan over high, 2 min:
Add and fry, stirring occasionally, 10+ min, until light brown:
items: 2 medium onions (1 lb / 450 g total), quartered and thinly sliced

steps.action: Add; break into ½ in (1.5 cm) pieces with the spatula and mix with the onions:
Add; press the potatoes against the pan to mash (leave lumps if you like), then fry 5 min, scraping occasionally:
